name: aws_fsx_lustre_file_system
description: High-performance parallel file system for compute-intensive workloads and HPC

subnet_ids.name: subnet_ids
subnet_ids.description: List of subnet IDs (currently only one subnet is supported)

storage_capacity.name: storage_capacity
storage_capacity.description: Storage capacity in GiB (min 1200 for SCRATCH_1/PERSISTENT_1, 1200 or multiples of 2400 for SCRATCH_2/PERSISTENT_2)

deployment_type.name: deployment_type
deployment_type.description: Deployment type (SCRATCH_1 for temporary, PERSISTENT_1/2 for longer-term, PERSISTENT_2 recommended)

per_unit_storage_throughput.name: per_unit_storage_throughput
per_unit_storage_throughput.description: Throughput in MB/s per TiB (PERSISTENT_1: 50/100/200, PERSISTENT_2: 125/250/500/1000)

security_group_ids.name: security_group_ids
security_group_ids.description: Security group IDs for the file system network interfaces

kms_key_id.name: kms_key_id
kms_key_id.description: ARN of KMS key for encryption (PERSISTENT_1/2 only, defaults to AWS managed key)

import_path.name: import_path
import_path.description: S3 URI as the data repository source (PERSISTENT_1 only, e.g., s3://bucket/prefix/)

export_path.name: export_path
export_path.description: S3 URI for export destination (PERSISTENT_1 only, auto-generated if not set)

auto_import_policy.name: auto_import_policy
auto_import_policy.description: How FSx keeps file/directory listings up to date (PERSISTENT_1 only)

automatic_backup_retention_days.name: automatic_backup_retention_days
automatic_backup_retention_days.description: Days to retain automatic backups (0-90, PERSISTENT_1/2 only)

copy_tags_to_backups.name: copy_tags_to_backups
copy_tags_to_backups.description: Copy file system tags to backups

daily_automatic_backup_start_time.name: daily_automatic_backup_start_time
daily_automatic_backup_start_time.description: Daily backup start time in HH:MM UTC format

skip_final_backup.name: skip_final_backup
skip_final_backup.description: Skip final backup on file system deletion

weekly_maintenance_start_time.name: weekly_maintenance_start_time
weekly_maintenance_start_time.description: Weekly maintenance window start time (d:HH:MM, d=1-7 Mon-Sun)

tags.name: tags
tags.description: Tags to apply to the file system
